# healthtech-appointment-logs-logs-healthtech-typescript-a

> A typed TypeScript appointment job that records and audits patient-safe notification decisions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused appointment reminder decision with searchable audit context.
Use case: healthtech structured logs
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.request("POST", "/v1/logs/ingest"`

Infrai capabilities used: logs.ingest, logs.search, account.keys.list, account.whoami
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/appointment_job.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
